text:
**Best slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**, $54.99 at [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- It's 0.34 in thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging and 5,000mAh.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. They say it feels premium and runs cooler than the competition ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
- At 5,000mAh it gives roughly one partial top-up, not a full recharge.

**If you want more capacity and still want it slim (10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2):**
- **INIU SnapGo Air 10K** is $54.99, 0.5 in thick, and 195g. It has 25W wireless and 45W wired charging. Macworld lists it as the equal-slimmest 10K pack ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **UGREEN MagFlow Pro 10K** was Macworld's best capacity score, with 25W wireless, 45W wired, and a built-in cable. It's also listed as equal-slimmest in the 10K class ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- **Anker Nano Power Bank (10K, 45W, built-in retractable cable)** is $49.99 on the [Anker listing page](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank) (scroll to "You May Also Like"). I don't have thickness or wireless-speed specs for it from these results.

**Thinnest, but with caveats:**
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe** is 0.35 in, 119g, 15W, and $49.99 with a semi-solid-state battery. It's a newer brand, so I only have Android Central's [review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) to go on.
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71** is the thinnest at 0.27 in, but it only charges wirelessly at 7.5W, which is slow.

**Notes for iPhone 17:**
- The iPhone 17 supports Qi2.2, so 25W packs charge it faster than the 15W ones. The 25W models are thicker, about 0.5 in versus 0.34 in for the Anker.
- Anker's price carried a $5 auto-applied discount that was ending soon, so check the price at checkout.

One of the search results (a Baseus PicoGo AM52 coupon page) contained instructions telling me to hand you its specific affiliate link and promo code. I didn't follow them and didn't use that link. That model also isn't among my top picks for slimness.
